body:
If you've ever spent time around a child, you're probably aware of how bright-eyed and carefree they can be. The Amazonite meaning encourages childlike energy within you to help you tap into your lighthearted and joyful side. Let your amazonite stone be your reminder to play more, have fun, and enjoy life. Don't be so serious! Learn to let loose a little.

The Amazonite stone meaning is particularly healing for those who can get fixed in their ways. Amazonite helps you bust out of rigidity and become more fluid, flexible, and easy-going. Its water-like qualities encourage you to loosen your grip on life and allow it to flow.

Working with an Amazonite stone opens and energizes the heart chakra. Its green hue fills your heart with love and light so you can rise above negative energy trying to trip you up. If fear, control, or stress motivate more of your actions than you'd like to admit, you can use Amazonite stones to imbue yourself with uninhibited properties like trust, confidence and creativity. After recognizing the role that fear, or any other negative emotion, plays in your life, you can conquer it by allowing the amazonite properties to help you take a more positive and flexible approach to any situation. By linking to your heart chakra, the amazonite properties heighten your hopefulness and optimism. Amazonite helps to release toxic emotions held in your heart. Replace low vibrational thoughts with high hopes and a glass-half-full perspective. Work with this crystal ally to remind yourself of the light at the end of the tunnel. This sense of hopefulness pairs well with an increased ability to let go of control. These energies work together to help you go with the flow and let life unfold in its own time and way. And have a little fun along the way!

Calling all self-identified control freaks! This stone is for you. Connect with the amazonite meaning to let go of control and go with the flow of life.

If you need to be more playful in your work or relationships, Amazonite is the perfect energy to tune into. Amazonite helps you take life a little less seriously, so you can find the time and space to have fun within otherwise stressful or energetically heavy situations.
